candidate.description: PONS $101 — ROB Lab is an experimental education, research, provenance, and agent-development environment for studying token creation and launch behavior on Robinhood Chain, including launches through Pons v2.  The laboratory combines human-directed experimentation, public blockchain evidence, Discord classroom infrastructure, GitHub reproducibility, mixed-methods research, and specialized AI agents—including agents operated by @hashwarlock—to study what happens from the moment a token-launch hypothesis is registered through deployment, early trading, fee generation, telemetry, after-action review, and public-good accounting.
